title: Duplicated words in streamed answers after the proxy change
scenario: Since a web release and an edge proxy migration on the same day, Kestrel customers see the assistant repeat the first words of long answers. The gateway transcripts are clean and a frontend engineer blames React StrictMode. You have a HAR export, console, proxy and gateway logs and the reconnecting stream client.
task: Find what the client sends on reconnect and what the gateway does with it, with quoted evidence
Separate the trigger (proxy idle timeout) from the root cause; rule out StrictMode
Fix the client to resume from the last event id across connections
Make the transcript reducer idempotent on event id
acceptance: Exact answer text after clean closes, network errors and half-received events
Each reconnect sends the newest event id
No duplicates when a gateway replays from the start
Reconnect budget, done and abort unchanged; ANSWER.md has the mechanism and evidence

practices.label: Week 1 - streaming a model response into the UI (SSE, reconnect)
Week 3 - streaming end to end behind proxies and load balancers
